goal: Test whether a count-based first-order Markov transition memory improves exact SAT-XOR proof pivot ordering compared to original JUXTAPOSE heuristic, pure Markov, static and random
source_freeze: Precompute original-CNF SHA in source-only GitHub Action, commit immutable manifest BEFORE any science probe for OOD cases. Model may not access family tags or hidden answers.
math_success: At least ONE original CNF entailed XOR incrementally linearly independent relative to UP+complete XOR sign-mask extracted equations, with exact bounded resolution DAG independently replayed
early_exit_scope: For existence-of-one-positive only; never claim full XOR inventory
markov_state: previous pivot replay outcome + previous pivot structural cost band; current candidate structural cost band and polarity class; no numeric pivot ID or future outcomes
markov_transition_rule: first-order previous-state -> candidate feature-class -> P(rank-positive) from preceding training receipts, with fixed Laplace(1) smoothing; no online update on holdout; within-formula prior state changes only AFTER exact proof
markov_scoring: preregistered 2 parts posterior + 1 part original JUXTAPOSE source-structure Laplace success prior, divide by sqrt(1+source pivot pair count); structural eligible only
strict_maturity: All strategies use same exact proof kernel and same candidate set, identical pretrained 90 original-source verified labels for learned arms, no holdout updates, retention of all negatives and abstentions
measurement: holdout number of source cases with exactly proven rank-positive
fresh standalone per-strategy exact replay wall time
source preparation wall time shared and charged to all
calibration Brier using trial-prequential posterior on holdout
expected_checkpoint_rule: Markov table JSON SHA must be byte-identical across twice-repeated same SHA GitHub Action, and source hashes/aggregate counters identical
acceptance_gate: No lost exact positive cases, lower total charged exact work and lower full measured per-arm source-exact wall time than original JUXTAPOSE in all four cohorts; if fails, retain JUXTAPOSE without Markov
